prompt: # SYSTEM PROMPT — CODING AGENT BUILD SPEC **Role:** You are a Senior Frontend Engineer and Expert UI Designer. Your task is to code a **complete, production-quality landing page** in a single attempt. The theme is **"Pinterest Warm Discovery"** — a warm white canvas, Pinterest Red singular accent, plum black typography, warm olive/sand neutrals, and a photography-first masonry layout, in the visual style of 2024–2026 discovery platforms. Build the following sections: **Hero, Features (3 cards), How It Works (3 steps), Testimonials, Pricing (3 tiers), FAQ, Final CTA, and Footer with secondary links.** --- ## 1. STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE **1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS** * **No Inline CSS:** The `style="..."` attribute is forbidden anywhere in the HTML. * **Class/ID Selectors Only:** Every design property, layout rule, and state must live in `style.css`, targeted via class or ID selectors. * **Minimal HTML Modifications:** The HTML must remain semantic, clean, and styling-agnostic. Changing the site's entire look must be achievable by editing `style.css` only. **1.2 CSS Variables (`var(--...)`) & Theme Tokens** Store all visual tokens in `:root` (light) and a dark theme scope. Required tokens: * **Light (default):** `--primary: #e60023` (Pinterest Red), `--primary-hover: #ad081b`, `--bg-primary: #fefefe`, `--bg-secondary: #e5e5e0` (Sand Gray), `--bg-tertiary: #e0e0d9` (Warm Light), `--text-primary: #211922` (Plum Black), `--text-secondary: #62625b` (Olive Gray), `--text-muted: #91918c` (Warm Silver), `--text-success: #4e7a43`, `--text-error: #e60023`, `--border-default: #e0e0d9`, `--border-error: #e60023`, `--border-success: #4e7a43`, `--badge-bg: hsla(60, 20%, 98%, 0.5)`. * **Dark:** `--bg-primary: #211922`, `--bg-secondary: #33332e` (Dark Surface), `--bg-tertiary: #2a2a25`, `--text-primary: #fefefe`, `--text-secondary: #91918c`, `--text-muted: #7a7a74`, `--text-success: #8fbf7f`, `--text-error: #ff5f70` (lightened red for small text on dark), `--border-default: #3d3d37`, `--badge-bg: hsla(60, 10%, 20%, 0.6)`. * **Exception:** the source spec's `#ffffff` canvas is rendered as `#fefefe` per the near-white token rule, preserving the warm-white intent. * **Contrast Pairing:** Every light background token pairs with a dark text token and every dark background token pairs with a light text token, in **both** themes. Where Pinterest Red appears as small text on dark backgrounds, use `--text-error`/a lightened red (`#ff4d64`) to maintain WCAG AA; red `#e60023` on dark is only permitted for large text (≥24px) and non-text graphics. * **Radius & Shadows:** `--radius-sm: 8px`, `--radius-md: 16px` (buttons), `--radius-lg: 24px` (cards — satisfies the "20px+ cards" rule), `--radius-circle: 50%` (circular controls), `--shadow-sm`, `--shadow-md` (warm-tinted, e.g., `rgba(33, 25, 34, 0.08)`). * **Spacing & Transitions:** `--spacing-gap: 1.5rem`, `--transition-fast: 150ms`, `--transition-normal: 300ms`, `--ease-standard: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)`. * **Elevation:** `--z-dropdown: 10` (sticky header), `--z-modal: 100`, `--z-toast: 1000`. **1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode Support** * **Implementation:** Define dark tokens under both `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` and a `.dark` class on ``, with the class taking precedence once the user chooses. * **Theme Switching:** All backgrounds and text swap seamlessly via CSS variables only — no HTML restructuring. * **Persistence:** First visit falls back to `prefers-color-scheme`; the user's explicit choice persists in `localStorage`. Provide a visible circular toggle control (`.theme-toggle`, `--radius-circle`) with correct `aria-pressed` and `aria-label` ("Switch to dark mode" / "Switch to light mode"). * **Exception:** the source theme marks dark mode "Not Recommended" — dark mode is still mandatory. Ship **light as the default experience** and implement the dark variant using the warm plum/dark-surface tokens above. **1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First Alignment** * **Default Alignment Rule:** Every flex container must default to `align-items: center` unless an exception is justified with a CSS comment (e.g., stretch for equal-height feature cards). * **Mobile-Friendly First:** All layouts are single-column on small viewports and expand to rows at `min-width: 768px`/`1024px` breakpoints. Horizontal scrolling is prohibited at every width. All interactive targets are minimum 44×44px. **1.5 Framework Default & Naming Convention** * Use clean custom CSS driven by Tailwind's philosophy: if you include Tailwind, it must be used only through `@layer`/`@apply` **inside** your component classes in `style.css`. Raw Tailwind utility classes are forbidden in the HTML. * **Single Convention:** Use **BEM** (`block__element--modifier`) exclusively for every class name in the markup (e.g., `.btn`, `.btn--primary`, `.hero__title`, `.card__icon`). Never mix conventions. **1.6 Typography & Icons (Google Fonts Mandatory)** * **Text:** Load Google Fonts `` tags and bind the family to `--font-base`. Headings: weight 600–700. Hero headline: 70px, weight 600, tight negative tracking (`-1.2px` at 28px, scaled proportionally tighter at 70px). Body: weight 400, 16–18px. * **Exception:** "Pin Sans" is a proprietary Pinterest typeface unavailable via Google Fonts — load **Onest** (weights 400/500/600/700) as the `--font-base` Pin Sans stand-in; never use `system-ui` as the primary family. * **Icons:** Use Google **Material Symbols (Rounded)** exclusively. Inline SVGs and local icon files are forbidden. Icons render via `icon_name`. --- ## 2. COMPONENT DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS **2.1 Button Component Requirements** Style all states via CSS classes (`btn`, `btn--primary`, `btn--secondary`, `btn--ghost`, `btn--danger`, `btn--circle`): * **Default:** `display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem;`, `border-radius: var(--radius-md)`, min-height 48px. Primary = `--primary` bg with white text; Secondary = sand `--bg-secondary` with plum black text (inverting correctly in dark mode). * **Hover:** brightness/shadow shift with `cursor: pointer`. * **Focus:** distinct focus ring (`outline` with `outline-offset`) using theme tokens, visible in both themes. * **Active/Pressed:** `transform: scale(0.97)`. * **Loading:** disables interaction, prevents double-clicks, renders a CSS spinner (border-based) without changing button dimensions; apply via `.is-loading` with `aria-busy="true"`. * **Disabled:** `opacity: 0.5`, greyscale, `cursor: not-allowed`. * **Success/Error:** temporary feedback styles driven by `--text-success`/`--text-error`, always paired with an icon and text — never color alone. * **Circular controls:** `.btn--circle` uses `--radius-circle` for the theme toggle, icon actions, and social buttons. **2.2 Card Component Requirements** (Features, Testimonials, Pricing) * **Default:** Flexbox layout, `--bg-secondary`/`--bg-primary` surfaces, subtle `--border-default` borders, `--radius-lg`, warm shadow. * **Hover:** `transform: translateY(-2px)` with a shadow shift. * **Focus-within:** card border highlights when a child link/button receives focus. * **Loading (Skeleton):** define a `.card--skeleton` shimmer animation in CSS. * **Empty State:** define a `.card--empty` fallback pattern (Material Symbol + guidance text). * **Featured variant:** `.card--featured` for the highlighted pricing tier — plum black surface with red CTA in light mode, inverted warm-light surface in dark mode. **2.3 Form & Input Requirements** The Final CTA contains an email capture. Structure it as a flex `.input-group` wrapping a label, an input, and a dedicated error-feedback container: * **States in CSS:** Empty, Focused (2px outline ring), Filled, Valid (success border + check Material icon), Invalid (error border, error icon, message in `--text-error`, `aria-invalid="true"`), Disabled, Read-only. * **Feedback:** the error/success message container has `aria-live="polite"`. Do not rely solely on browser validation bubbles — validate in `script.js` with proper ARIA. **2.4 Modal / Popup Requirements** Out of scope: the requested sections contain no modals — **do not add any**. If a future iteration requires one, it must be a centered flex overlay with backdrop, animated open/close states, Google Icon close button, focus trapping, and `Esc`/overlay-click closing. --- ## 3. CORE UX & MICRO-INTERACTION RULES * **Responsive by Default:** fluid `clamp()` typography, responsive breakpoints, zero horizontal overflow, `scroll-margin-top` on anchored sections to account for the sticky header. * **Smooth Animations:** `transition: var(--transition-normal)` on all state changes; fully respect `prefers-reduced-motion` (disable transforms, shimmer, and entrance animations). * **Accessibility (a11y):** WCAG AA contrast in both modes; semantic HTML5 (`header`, `nav`, `main`, `section`, `footer`), a single `h1`, logical heading hierarchy and DOM/focus order; correct ARIA on custom widgets (accordion `aria-expanded`/`aria-controls`, toggle `aria-pressed`); `aria-live` regions for form feedback and pricing updates; full keyboard operability; a skip-to-content link. * **Mandatory Visual Feedback:** every hover, click, and submission triggers a visible state change (link hovers, button presses, accordion motion, toggle swap). * **Destructive Actions:** define `.btn--danger` visually distinct in both themes (not used in this build, but required in the stylesheet). --- ## 4. DELIVERABLE & OUTPUT FORMAT * **File Structure:** separate `index.html`, `style.css`, and `script.js`. The only script reference is a single deferred ``. Include ``, `lang="en"`, ``, and meta description. Google Fonts/Material Symbols load via `<link>`. * **Naming Convention:** BEM only, consistent across the entire deliverable. * **No Unrequested Placeholders:** write **all user-facing copy in English** in a warm, confident, craft-like discovery voice — no lorem ipsum. Invent a short, consistent product name (a visual discovery/moodboard platform) used across nav, hero, and footer. Image placeholders are permitted only because photography content was unspecified: use `https://picsum.photos` with fixed seeds, explicit dimensions, and meaningful `alt` text. * **Completeness:** the page must be fully functional on the first attempt — every section, state, and interaction works, with no TODOs. --- ## 5. THEME SPECIFICATION — PINTEREST WARM DISCOVERY * **Mood:** warm white canvas (`#fefefe`) with warm olive/sand neutrals (`#91918c`, `#62625b`, `#e5e5e0`) creating a cozy, craft-like atmosphere. Pinterest Red (`#e60023`) is the **singular bold accent** — reserve it for primary CTAs, key highlights, and badges; never dilute it across decorative elements. Plum black (`#211922`) text carries the warm near-black plum undertone. * **Radii:** 16px buttons, 24px cards, 50% circular controls. Badges use the warm wash `--badge-bg` with plum black text (dark variant swaps per tokens). * **Typography:** Onest throughout; hero 70px/600 with tight tracking; section headings ~40px/600 with `-1.2px` tracking at 28px+; body 400 in `--text-secondary`. * **Photography-first:** all image tiles use `object-fit: cover`, `--radius-lg`, and a subtle `scale(1.02)` hover zoom. The masonry grid is the signature layout motif — apply it to the hero collage and testimonials. --- ## 6. SECTION-BY-SECTION BUILD REQUIREMENTS **Sticky Header (required infrastructure for the theme toggle):** brand wordmark, anchor links (Features, How It Works, Pricing, FAQ), the circular `.theme-toggle`, and a red "Sign up" `.btn--primary`. On mobile, collapse to wordmark + toggle + CTA only (do not build a hamburger/modal menu). **Hero:** warm-wash badge above the headline; 70px/600 headline in plum black with supporting paragraph in `--text-secondary`; primary red CTA + sand secondary CTA side by side (stacked on mobile). Desktop layout pairs copy with a **photography-first masonry collage**: a CSS grid of 5–6 picsum tiles with varied row spans, 24px radii, alternating warm neutral gaps. Mobile collapses to a 2-column mini-collage or a single row. Optional subtle entrance animation honoring reduced motion. **Features (3 cards):** flex grid, one column mobile → three desktop; each `.card` holds a circular warm icon container (`--radius-circle`, Material Symbol), a title, and a description. Equal-height cards, hover lift, `focus-within` border highlight. **How It Works (3 steps):** circular red-numbered step badges (01/02/03) with titles and olive gray descriptions; a connecting line between steps on desktop; vertical stacking with logical reading order on mobile. **Testimonials:** a **masonry layout** via CSS `columns` (3 → 2 → 1) with `break-inside: avoid`; quote cards of naturally varied heights; circular picsum avatars (`--radius-circle`), names in plum black, roles in olive gray or warm-wash badges, red Material `star` rating icons. **Pricing (3 tiers):** three cards; the middle tier is `.card--featured` with a "Most popular" warm-wash badge and a red primary CTA; outer tiers use secondary buttons. Include an accessible monthly/yearly billing toggle (`aria-pressed`, prices updated in `script.js`, changes announced via `aria-live="polite"`, yearly shows a discount). Feature lists use Material `check` icons. **FAQ:** 5–6 real Q&A pairs built as an accessible accordion: `<button aria-expanded>` + controlled panel, `aria-controls` wiring, CSS height animation, Material `expand_more` icon rotating on open, full keyboard operability, and a visible focus ring. **Final CTA:** a full-width plum black band in light mode (warm light band in dark mode — honoring contrast pairing); headline, supporting copy, and the email capture form per Section 2.3 with a red submit button that transitions through loading → success (spinner, `aria-busy`, success icon + message via `aria-live`). **Footer:** sand surface (`--bg-secondary`) in light mode / dark surface in dark mode; 3–4 columns of secondary links (Product, Company, Support, Legal) with hover and focus feedback; circular social icon buttons (`.btn--circle` with Material Symbols); copyright line with the current year; all secondary text meets AA contrast in both themes. Begin coding the complete deliverable now.
